tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgos bskang zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra samba rashtsa dai ya shwa na pa ti na maḥ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i sgos bskang las/ spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /rab dkar keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dam tshig can la brtser dgongs te/ /nor gyi bdag po yab yum yang / /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang / /dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sha ma shwa na pa ti sa pā ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi/ /thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ro bcud brgya ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rakta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /byon skyems dam par 'bul gyi dgyes par gsol/ /mtshan sngags kyi rjes su/ badzra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ gtor sngags tshar gsum brjod/ phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul/ 'phrin las bcol/ de nas bstod cing bskul la/ bskang ba dngos ni chos skyong nyid kyi zhal gsung ma gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ hūm̐ dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /keng rus thod pa'i gur nang na/ /rakta'i rba klong dkyil 'khor na/ /mi ro bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /dpal ldan dur khrod bdag po ni/ /gti mug spangs phyir keng rus sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /zhe sdang 'joms phyir thod dbyug 'phyar/ /'dod chags mtsho skem thod khrag stobs/ /g.yas pa'i thod dbyug 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i klad pa 'joms/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag gang gis/ /dgra dang bgegs kyi snying khrag 'thung / /'bar ba'i keng rus mche ba gtsigs/

/dug gsum rtsad nas gcod par byed/ /dbu la rin chen dprog zhu gsol/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter dang ldan/ /mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa yin/ /sku la rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster/ /gnyis med shes rab yum chen mo/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yab dang mthun/ /'jigs su rung ba'i yab yum sku/ /brkyangs bskums gar gyis gdug pa 'dul/ /gad mo sgrogs shing khros thabs tshul/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing / /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i dbang phyug ste/ /rigs sngags bzlog pa'i mthu bo che/ /rang rtags srog snying sgra sgrogs shing / /dpal ldan yab yum thugs rje can/ /khyod kyi sprul pas gar yang khyab/ /rtsa gsum lha gnas man chad nas/ /na rag dmyal khams yan chad du/ /sprul pa bye ba dpag med 'gyed/ /lha srin sde brgyad khyed kyi 'khor/ /stong phrag brgyad cu khyod kyi bran/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di/ /khro rngams stabs kyis bzhes su gsol/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu ma chung / /rnal 'byor skyong phyir thugs ma ring / /gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang ma zhan/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul/ /thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /bsrung pa'i 'khor lo skyabs ma chung / /'gro ba srungs shig thugs rje can/ /bdag gis mchod cing bstod pa'i tshe/ /dkor khang bsrung shing bar chad sol/ /yon bdag bsrung shing skyobs pa dang / /rnal 'byor bsam pa bsgrub pa dang / /chos skyong thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /bsod nams dpag med bskyed pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam bzhin du phrin las mdzod/ /ces so/ /spro na mtshams 'dir 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bskang bshags bzlog bskul bstod pa 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad bsam don kun 'grub phrin las mkha' khyab bya/

yang bstod pa cung zad rgyas pa la dga' na yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi gsung bzhin bya ste/ hūm̐ rgyal ba'i thugs rje phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul pa'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par/ /gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /yang dag lam la nyer gnas te/ /lus can bde la 'god mdzad cing / /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ /phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod bsgrub khyod mchod na/ /dam bcas ji bzhin nyer dgongs nas/ /ji ltar gsol ba ji bzhin du/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang / /dngos grub kun stsol dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod/ /phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod/ /zhing skyong yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma sogs/ bstabs pa ni gur zhal sogs spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /chos skyong 'di'i sngags la dag min sna tshogs snang yang rgyud dang man ngag gi dgongs pa dbyug tho'i snying po yig 'bru bco lnga pa 'khrul med ni/ oṃ ghṛ ra dza ghṛ ra dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ thi swāhā/ 'di kho na'o/ /zhes zhing skyong yab yum gyi sgos bskang nyung du 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bsgrigs/ ༈ /rnam sras bang mdzod kyi rnam sras gtor 'dzugs dang gtor spod maṅga'i mtshan can gyi sku thog la byung / dur khrod bdag po'i sku dang gtor spod lto zan byed rgyu 'di yang yab rje rdo rje 'chang sku na phra mo nas bzung da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad kyang gtor ma 'di dgos dang bskang gso 'di gtong gi deb mi 'dug pas shing bya lo nas bzung / nged rang gi 'dzugs bkod bgyis par 'dzugs gtor sngar bzhin mchod gtor dam rdzas gsum/

bsdus bskang 'phar dur khrod bdag por zur du gtor ma mig gsum rgyan can gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ phud chang rnams bshams nas/ sku gnyer gzhi thog pa bzhi dang lha khang rtse pa bcas tshogs la/ phur chung gtor bsngo bshags pa gsum/ bskang gsar gyi byin brlabs thugs rje ma rdzogs nas dur khrod bdag po'i spyan 'dren la dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren dbyangs rol/ byon skyems phul sngags mchod pa/ 'phrin bcol/ bstod bskul tshig rkang bcu gsum ma mgon po 'khor dang ma'i dbyangs gnyis gang rung / de phyin 'dur shur ci rigs kyi mthar/ thugs dam bzhin du la tshig rol/ bde chen lhun grub ma bcas tshar bdun bgyid rgyu'i gnyis pa man la bstod bskul/ 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol/ bzhi par bde chen lhun grub mar dbyangs/ bdun par rab dkar nyi mar dbyangs/ bde chen lhun grub ma dang rab dkar nyi mar dbyangs med tshe shlau ka dang po la gzhan sbrel nas gtong ba las tshig rol mi dgos/ dur khrod bdag po'i grangs gsog rdzogs nas bdud dpung kun 'joms ma/ dpal gyi bstan skyong ma/ sku dang gsung thugs ma gcig rtsa brgyud bla ma/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma gcig 'phrin bcol man bskang gsar bzhin/ bstod pa nag rngams ma/ dur khrod bdag po'i bstod pa rgyas par shlau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs rol/ gtor 'bul lha mo'i spyan 'dren dbyangs rol/ bkra shis 'jigs rung sogs bgyid rgyu 'di yang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgos bskang zhing skyong dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
